attributes.board_name: Maryland Board of Examiners for Audiologists, Hearing Aid Dispensers, Speech-Language Pathologists and Music Therapists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved programs; activities directly concerning SLP/audiology need no separate approval. Academic courses (3-credit course = 15 CEUs, 2 = 10, 1 = 5); conference lectures, workshops and in-service programs; presenting (max 3); papers (max 10 first author), book chapter (max 10), journal editing/reviewing (max 8 per year); open Board meetings (max 5 per cycle); independent study with passed post-test (no limit); Board-approved pro bono work (max 10)
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE waived for SLPs/audiologists obtaining full licensure within 6 months of the renewal cycle; prorated for those fully licensed at least 6 months but less than 2 years (incl. reinstatements and transfers).
rules.audit_note: Signed attestation at renewal; 10% of renewal applications audited each renewal period; keep certificates 4 years. Late renewals may be audited.

topics.who: All licensees: at least 1 CEU within the 20 CEUs in the area of licensure
All licensees: at least 1 CEU in ethics within the 20 CEUs in the area of licensure

All licensees: attest at the first renewal after April 1, 2026 to an implicit bias course with a structural racism component (one-time; earlier Board guidance: approved implicit bias courses do not count toward CE hours)

rules.notes: 30 CEUs = at least 20 in the area of licensure plus up to 10 in related areas (supervision, billing, interdisciplinary collaboration, practice management); 2 CEUs in supervision recommended. Dual audiologist + SLP: 40 CEUs (at least 15 in each area). Full licenses are renewed by May 31 of the expiration year (Board renewal window April 1 - May 31; practice prohibited after June 30 if not renewed); licenses are issued for terms of up to 2 years. Proposed 2026 amendments (one-time cultural competency before first renewal; extra audiology topics) were out for public review and are not yet effective.

rules.audit_note: 25% of assistants are audited at renewal; audited assistants submit their latest performance evaluation and CE documentation from the 2 years before expiration.

topics.who: Recommended (not mandatory): at least 1 CEU within the 5 work-related CEUs
Recommended (not mandatory): at least 1 CEU in ethics within the 5 work-related CEUs

rules.notes: 10 CEUs = 5 in clinical practice + 5 in work-related areas; job orientation/maintenance training does not count. License term up to 2 years; renewal also needs a delegation agreement for each supervising SLP or audiologist. The one-time implicit bias/structural racism attestation applies to all health occupation licensees.
